svg.title: Where the voice turn's seconds go on what an operator can deploy
svg.desc: The voice turn's mean voice-to-voice time stacked by stage from the end of the caller's speech, beside 24 agent sessions but for voice alone: voice alone, 1.60 s, 0.09 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.21 s decoding the first sentence; tuned vLLM, 5.21 s, 2.78 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 1.02 s decoding the first sentence; a token reservation, 3.38 s, 0.95 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 1.01 s decoding the first sentence; preempt-resubmit, 2.02 s, 0.28 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.34 s decoding the first sentence; the lifecycle policy, 1.83 s, 0.23 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.20 s decoding the first sentence; the configuration to deploy, 1.95 s, 0.28 s of it waiting for the LLM's first token and 0.25 s decoding the first sentence.
svg.text: Wait for the LLM's first token
Mean time from the end of the caller's speech (s)
